name: Hardware Volume Rendering Pipeline with Pixel Textures
aliases: Hardware Volume Rendering Pipeline (Pixel Texture Based)
Hardware-Accelerated Volume Rendering Pipeline with Pixel Textures
definition: A volume rendering pipeline using OpenGL pixel textures (dependent textures) for classification and shading, utilizing separate data and shading volumes.
summary: Hardware Volume Rendering Pipeline with Pixel Textures uses dependent texture lookups to decouple data storage from shading, differing from proxy geometry by rasterizing parallel planes and from PixelFlow by relying on fixed-function extensions.
